implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure signals a material shareholding threshold event; the acquirer must now either make a full public open offer (if crossing 25%) or seek exemption from SEBI, triggering disclosure timelines, director appointment rights, and board composition scrutiny.

framework.note: Central: Mandatory disclosure requirement for substantial acquisition exceeding 25% of voting capital; triggers open offer or exemption route.
Open offer obligation: acquirer must make public offer to remaining shareholders if no exemption granted; minimum 90% of highest price paid.
Exemptions: SEBI may exempt from open offer on grounds of public interest, inter-corporate restructuring, inheritance or gift.
Board composition and director appointment changes post-acquisition; scrutiny for nominee directors and independent director requirements.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, Section 23(1)
framework.note: Regulatory authority of SEBI to issue directions and intervene in takeover proceedings.
Acquirer and related parties subject to insider trading restrictions during disclosure and offer period.
Continuous disclosure obligations; related party transactions and material events must be reported to exchanges.

headline: SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure: Lakhmendra Chamanlal Khurana Files Regulation 31(4) Notice for Landsmill Green Limited
sum: Lakhmendra Chamanlal Khurana has submitted a formal disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), the mandatory notice requirement for any shareholder acquiring 25% or more of voting rights in a listed company, to the NSE for Landsmill Green Limited.
detail: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 mandate that any person acquiring 25% or more of voting rights must disclose to the company and stock exchange within the prescribed timeline. This filing by Lakhmendra Chamanlal Khurana to NSE indicates either a threshold crossing or an intermediate disclosure step. The substantive terms—acquisition size, consideration, conditions precedent and open offer mechanics—are not detailed in the source extract and would be contained in the full disclosure document.
